name: Hon Noroi! durbbing girls revival fest
original_name: ほん呪！ durbbing girls revival fest
source:
A story about a young man who watched a cursed video, and Sadako.

There's a rumor that if you watch this cursed video, in seven days you will die. Tetsugoro Yasuno, a part-time worker, was unfortunate enough to stumble upon the video. And so on the seventh day after he watched it, Yasuno's ordinary life slowly begins to collapse. 

A series of three linear visual novels, play time for the first is approximately 40 minutes.
translation:
一个关于贞子与不慎看了诅咒录像带的青年的故事。

传闻有一盘“诅咒录像带”，只要看过就会在七天后死去。靠打零工维生的安野铁五郎不幸看完了这盘录像带。于是，在观看后的第七天，安野平静的日常生活开始缓缓崩塌。

本系列共有三部线性视觉小说，第一部的游玩时长约为40分钟。
